Inter Account Transfer

Footer templates allow you to add standardized text at the bottom of inter account transfer forms.

Use footers to document internal money movements, add authorization notes, or include reconciliation instructions.

Overview

Create multiple footer templates to handle different types of transfers between your accounts.

Each footer can contain specific text for different transfer scenarios, such as cash management transfers or foreign currency movements.

Name
Name

Creating Footer Templates

To create a new footer template, click the New Footer button.

Enter a descriptive name that clearly identifies the purpose of the footer, such as 'Cash Management Transfers' or 'Foreign Currency Movements'.

Common Uses

Footer templates for inter account transfers are commonly used to include:

• Transfer authorization signatures or approval codes

• Internal control reference numbers

• Reconciliation notes or instructions

• Cash management or treasury department instructions

• Compliance or audit trail documentation

Using Footer Templates

When creating an inter account transfer, you can select from your saved footer templates.

The selected footer text will appear at the bottom of the transfer form, providing consistent documentation across similar transfers.

This ensures proper record-keeping and helps maintain internal control procedures for money movements between accounts.
